purpose: Teach: 地方裁判所/光学/良識/米価/併合/異質/筆記/伝授

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 桜さん、地方裁判所の判例研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Sakura, you wrote your paper on case law precedent from local courts, didn't you?
lines.style: Warm, measured opening. A slight lift of genuine curiosity — she's checking in, not interrogating. Patient pause before the question tag, inviting agreement.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、光学顕微鏡の解像度を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes — I covered optical microscope resolution in mine.
lines.style: Straightforward, matter-of-fact. A touch of careful correctness. Not defensive, just precise. Steady eye contact level.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 市民の良識形成を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: You focused on how ordinary citizens develop informed judgment, correct?
lines.style: Thoughtful, slightly reflective tone. Genuine question underneath — she's listening to what Sakura chose. Unhurried pacing.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、米価の長期変動を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes — my paper looked at long-term fluctuations in rice prices.
lines.style: Clear and direct. A hint of self-assurance without arrogance. The delivery of someone comfortable with what she's chosen.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 近世の国家併合史を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: And you examined historical patterns of state consolidation in the early modern period?
lines.style: Engaged, following a thread of interest. Forward momentum in the voice. The question carries respect for the topic choice.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、異質な文化の共生を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes — I explored how different cultures can coexist and enrich each other.
lines.style: Sincere, almost gentle. A pause before she finishes — she means this part. Not performed earnestness, real conviction.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 筆記試験形式の妥当性を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: So you wrote about the validity of written examinations as an assessment method?
lines.style: Reflective, slightly slower. A teacher's genuine curiosity about pedagogy. Soft landing on the question.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、伝統工芸の伝授制度を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes — I focused on how traditional crafts are passed down through formal apprenticeship systems.
lines.style: Clear, assured conclusion. A quiet fullness to the final words. She's done here, and she's satisfied with what she's said.
